$meta.name: Equal AI Design System
$meta.notes: Single source of truth. Run `npm run tokens` to regenerate web (CSS + TS) and Compose (Kotlin) outputs. Tokens flagged "proposed": true are NOT in the colour guide; they were derived from the component references / typography inventory and need designer sign-off. Dark values are implemented exactly as written in the Alias Tokens design.

bg/primary.darkWhy: Dark value updated from {brand.black} to match the dark screens in the flow designs + Contact Info design (sampled).
bg/primary.why: The app canvas behind lists, chats and sheets; the Colours collection sets it to #FAFAFA / #141414 (one-off #F7F7F7/#F8F8F8 header fills snap to it).

bg/surface.why: Raised surfaces such as list rows, cards, inputs and chips; white in light and #1F1F1F in dark per the Colours collection.

bg/overlay.why: The dimming layer behind bottom sheets and dialogs; Figma's Overlay variable is #1E1E1E at 40% in both themes.

text/primary.why: Body text, titles and names; Colours text/primary is black at 80% (white at 80% in dark), and one-off greys #3C3C3C/#242424/#333333/#111111 snap to it.

text/placeholder.why: Placeholder text in inputs and search only (2.85:1, so never for readable labels); Colours text/placeholder black/white at 40%.

text/secondary.why: Previews, captions, dates and secondary labels (5.7:1 on white); one-off greys #858484/#676767/#9F9F9F/#545454/#5E5E5E snap here for AA.

text/action-disabled.why: Disabled text buttons and inactive indicators; takes the Colours text/disabled value.

text/action.why: Text buttons, links and accent headings; brand green in light, lime in dark.

text/on-action.why: Labels and icons on primary buttons and badges: white on green in light, black on lime in dark.

text/on-action-disabled.why: Label on a disabled filled button; no Figma evidence found, so the value is left as is pending a check of the Button component set.

button/primary.why: Filled primary buttons, switches and active indicators; green in light, lime in dark.

button/secondary.why: The lime accent used as the start of the brand gradients and secondary fills; inverts to green in dark per the Colours collection.
button/secondary.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime. (The library swaps secondary to green in dark; the rule overrides it.)

button/tonal.why: The tinted “+ Apply” pill on recommended cards and preset instructions (Preset Instruction design): brand green at 8 % behind a green label.
button/tonal.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime; the tint is lime at 12 % so it still reads on the dark card.

button/secondary-label.why: Label of the Secondary button (Default appearance): Figma Button "Secondary" uses #009837 on the pale-green gradient.
button/secondary-label.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime.

button/secondary-stroke.why: Inner edge of the Secondary button: Figma strokes it white at 70 % over the gradient.

button/critical-stroke.why: Inner edge of the Critical Secondary button (Figma #FFE0E0 at 70 %).

text/on-secondary.why: Label on the lime secondary button (button/secondary): black in both themes, because white on lime is unreadable.

button/danger.why: Destructive buttons such as Delete; Colours brand/danger is #C50000 in light and #FF5151 in dark.

button/disabled.why: Fill of a disabled filled button and switch track; no Figma evidence found, value left as is.

stroke/subtle.darkWhy: Dark value updated from #F6F6F6 to match the dark screens in the flow designs + Contact Info design (sampled).
stroke/subtle.why: Hairline dividers and the faintest card and chip outlines.

stroke/medium.darkWhy: Dark value updated from #F7F7F7 to match the dark screens in the flow designs + Contact Info design (sampled).
stroke/medium.why: Outlines of inputs, the composer field and date pills.

stroke/dark.darkWhy: Dark value updated from #F8F8F8 to match the dark screens in the flow designs + Contact Info design (sampled).
stroke/dark.why: Strong outlines such as unchecked radios and checkboxes.

stroke/focus.why: A focused text input (composer, text field, search, assistant field): a solid 1.5 px brand-green outline and nothing else, no black focus ring (Figma composer, selected empty state).
stroke/focus.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime.

action/stroke/unread.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.
action/stroke/unread.why: Outline of unread/active action chips and the green glow on the assistant toggle.

action/fill/unread.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.
action/fill/unread.why: The faint lime wash for unread chips and selected choice cards; lime at 8% in both themes.

component/chip/label-unread.why: Label and chevron of an unread action pill (Call Back, Update Address…). Figma: #3C3C3C in light, #D3D4D1 in dark; 10.3:1 and 12.4:1.

component/chip/label-read.why: Label and chevron of a read action pill. Figma: #3C3C3C in light; dark keeps text secondary (white 60%).

action/bottom-color.why: Android only: the inner bottom highlight of the glass action chips and the Takeover pill (eqGlassInset). Web draws the same edge with a CSS inset shadow.

component/chat-bubble/user-bg.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.
component/chat-bubble/user-bg.why: Your own sent chat bubble: a pale green in light and a lime-hued dark tint in dark.

component/chat-bubble/user-title.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.
component/chat-bubble/user-title.why: The 'You' sender line in your own bubble; dark green passes AA at 7.2:1 on the bubble.

component/action-card/highlight.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.
component/action-card/highlight.why: Selected chat-list row and soft green badges; the Conversation component's selected fill.

text/danger.why: Destructive text actions such as 'Delete instruction'; same red as the danger button.

text/on-danger.why: Labels on the danger button: white on dark red, black on the lighter dark-mode red.

text/on-dark.why: Text on always-dark chips such as the playback speed pill.

text/on-dark-secondary.why: Secondary text (price) on the dark plan card; needs checking against the monetization pages.

text/accent-gold.why: Paints the word 'UNLIMITED' on the dark plan card in #CFA846, the solid end of Figma's cream-to-gold text gradient (6.0:1 on the card).

component/chat-bubble/contact-title.why: Amber sender line on an incoming bubble from a business contact; Figma's #AF6307 passes AA at 4.55:1 on white.
component/chat-bubble/contact-title.darkWhy: Derived: no dark business bubble in Figma; light amber keeps AA on #292929.

component/chat-bubble/other-bg.why: Incoming chat bubble surface: white in light, #292929 in dark.

component/plan-card/bg.why: Fills the dark 'Equal AI UNLIMITED' plan card in Settings with Figma's #2E2E2E charcoal, which stays dark in both modes.

component/plan-card/pill-stroke.why: Outlines the 'Current Plan' pill on the plan card in Figma's pale cream #FFF2C3.

component/rating/star-filled.why: Fills the selected stars on the 'How would you rate the call?' card in brand green (lime in dark), as Figma draws them.

component/rating/star-empty.why: Fills the unselected rating stars with Figma's #2B2B2B at 36% so they read as empty against the filled green ones.

component/nav/selected-bg.why: The selected tab capsule is brand green at 4% alpha (about #F5FCF7 on the white nav), not a solid #F1FAF3; dark re-hues to lime and raises alpha to 8% (the action/unread_fill level) because 4% is invisible on dark.
component/nav/selected-bg.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/playback/pill-bg.why: The '1x' playback-speed pill on voice notes.

component/waveform/bar.why: Unplayed voice-note waveform bars; Figma's light grey (non-text, so below 3:1 by design choice).

component/waveform/bar-played.why: Played portion of the waveform, showing progress in brand green.
component/waveform/bar-played.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

component/notice/bg.why: Figma's notice pill is a fainter lime tint than the token; dark mirrors the alpha variant in lime. Note Figma sets the notice text to text/primary while the web uses text/secondary.
component/notice/bg.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/plan-card/pattern.why: Draws the gold line pattern on the right of the plan card; #C9A55A at low opacity reproduces Figma's colour-dodged gold lines.

component/invite/bg.why: Figma's invite card is #F1FFF6 (slightly greener than #F0FBF2); dark keeps the lime-re-hued surface. Radius in Figma is 20, the web uses 24.
component/invite/bg.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/invite/stroke.why: The outline is brand green at 10% alpha rather than a solid mint; dark uses lime at the same alpha per the dark-mode rule.
component/invite/stroke.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/chip/selected-bg.why: Selected segmented chip is #313131 in Figma (token had #333333); dark inverts to a light chip.

component/chip/selected-text.why: The label on the dark chip is #F7F7F7 (bg/primary), not pure white; 13.4:1 on #313131. Dark mirrors the chip inversion.

component/preset/tint-green.why: Behind the 3D shield of the Screen & Protect preset (#48FF8A at 16 %). Dark re-hues to lime.
component/preset/tint-green.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/preset/tint-orange.why: Behind the 3D briefcase of the Run my business preset (#FF9908 at 16 %); the alpha tint also works on dark, so dark keeps it.

component/chat/wallpaper-bg.why: Chat background under the doodle wallpaper.

component/voice/player-bg.why: Voice-note player inside an incoming call-summary bubble.

component/voice/player-bg-sent.why: Voice-note player inside your own sent bubble, a green tint that sits on the bubble.
component/voice/player-bg-sent.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/chat/wallpaper-pattern.why: Doodle pattern drawn over the chat background.

component/status-card/pill-bg.why: The Temporarily Unavailable system status card is not in this Figma file; keep the current value until the owner confirms where it comes from or deletes the component.

component/status-card/button.why: Not in Figma; current amber kept pending owner decision.

component/status-card/button-text.why: Not in Figma; current AA-safe #3D2600 kept pending owner decision.

component/brand/whatsapp.why: WhatsApp glyph on the action card; Figma draws it in brand green, not WhatsApp's #25D366.
component/brand/whatsapp.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

text/gold.why: Colours gold labels on the paywall (coupon code, APPLY, EQUAL Unlimited) in Figma's #B4792E, which is 3.7:1 on white so it suits large or bold labels only. Darkened in the same hue from Figma’s #B4792E so it passes AA 4.5:1 on white, the paywall hero cream (#FDEFC6) and the active expiry chip.

component/paywall/card-bg.why: Fills the paywall preview card in Figma's warm off-white #FFFDF8 so it sits softly on the gold hero.

component/paywall/card-stroke.why: Outlines the paywall preview card in Figma's neutral #F0F0F0 (#3D3D3D on dark cards), not a gold tint.

component/paywall/divider.why: Draws the hairlines either side of paywall section labels in Figma's #A37135 at 50%, which fade out at the ends.

component/plan-banner/bg.why: Fills the 'Reactivate your current Plan' strip in Figma's cream #FFEFC8.

component/plan-banner/text.why: Colours the text and info icon on the reactivate strip in Figma's #A6691C (4.0:1 on its fill, just under AA for body text). Darkened from Figma’s #A6691C (4.0:1) to pass AA 4.5:1 for text.

component/locked/badge-bg.why: Fills the circle behind the gold lock on locked rows and bubbles in Figma's near-white #FCFCFC so the gold lock stands out.

component/expiry-banner/warning-bg.why: Fills the 'Your Plan Expires in 2 Days · Renew Now' strip in Figma's amber cream #FFF0D3.

component/expiry-banner/warning-text.why: Colours the text, icon and Renew Now on the expiry warning strip in Figma's dark brown #763D00 (7.7:1).

component/expiry-banner/danger-bg.why: Fills the 'Your Plan Expires Today / Expired' strip in Figma's pale red #FFE8E8.

component/expiry-banner/danger-text.why: Colours the text, icon and Renew Now on the expired strip in Figma's deep red #6E0000 (10.8:1).

component/whats-new/bg.why: Flat fill of the What's New card.
component/whats-new/bg.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

component/whats-new/glow.why: Blurred highlight circle behind the What's New illustration.
component/whats-new/glow.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

component/missed-call/bg.why: Warm tint of the missed-call card header.
component/missed-call/bg.darkWhy: Derived: no dark missed-call card in Figma.

component/missed-call/stroke.why: Hairline around the missed-call card header.

component/missed-call/icon.why: Red-orange missed-call glyph (4.0:1 on its disc, above 3:1 for icons).

component/expiry-chip/warning-bg.why: Fills the '03 Days' chip on the value card in Figma's #FFF1D5 (bright amber #FEBD6B on the dark card).

component/expiry-chip/warning-text.why: Colours the '03 Days' chip text in Figma's #6E4900 (near-black #2D1900 on the amber dark chip) for strong contrast.

component/expiry-chip/danger-bg.why: Fills the 'Today' / '30th July' chip on the value card in Figma's pale red #FFD5D5.

component/expiry-chip/danger-text.why: Colours the 'Today' / '30th July' chip text in Figma's deep red #6E0000 (9.5:1).

component/expiry-chip/active-bg.why: Fills the '25th Jun ’26' plan-active chip, which reuses the warning chip's #FFF1D5 in Figma.

component/value-card/stroke.why: Outlines the 'What Unlimited saved you' card in Figma's neutral #F0F0F0 (#3D3D3D in dark).

component/value-card/perks-bg.why: Fills the three perk rows inside the value card in white, and Figma's #242424 on the dark card.

component/value-card/ring.why: Paints the concentric rings behind the calls-handled number; Figma bakes them into an image, so the current gold tints stay until a vector source exists.

component/plan-card/expired-pill.why: Fills the 'Plan Expired' pill on the plan card with Figma's red base #CD3200 so white text reads at 5.2:1.

component/sunburst/ray.why: Paints the slowly rotating rays behind success art in white at 5%, as Figma's Reward Animation does.

component/premium-icon/start.why: Sets the centre of the gold radial on premium perk icons, #D1A85C in light and Figma's brighter #FEC378 on dark cards.

component/premium-icon/end.why: Sets the edge of the gold radial on premium perk icons, #A0621F in light and Figma's #FA8C01 on dark cards.

component/contact-avatar/blue-bg.why: Disc behind a saved contact's initials; the only initials disc colour Figma uses.
component/contact-avatar/blue-bg.darkWhy: Derived: no dark initials disc in Figma.

component/contact-avatar/blue-text.why: Initials on the blue disc; kept slightly darker than Figma's #377594 so readable text passes 4.5:1.

component/contact-avatar/green-bg.why: Figma has no green initials disc; saved-contact initials use the blue disc.
component/contact-avatar/green-bg.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/contact-avatar/green-text.why: Figma has no green initials colour; use the blue disc's initials colour.
component/contact-avatar/green-text.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

component/contact-avatar/purple-bg.why: Figma has no purple initials disc; saved-contact initials use the blue disc.

component/contact-avatar/purple-text.why: Figma has no purple initials colour; use the blue disc's initials colour.

component/contact-avatar/orange-bg.why: Figma has no orange initials disc; saved-contact initials use the blue disc.

component/contact-avatar/orange-text.why: Figma has no orange initials colour; use the blue disc's initials colour.

component/contact-avatar/pink-bg.why: Figma has no pink initials disc; saved-contact initials use the blue disc.

component/contact-avatar/pink-text.why: Figma has no pink initials colour; use the blue disc's initials colour.

component/contact-avatar/teal-bg.why: Figma has no teal initials disc; saved-contact initials use the blue disc.

component/contact-avatar/teal-text.why: Figma has no teal initials colour; use the blue disc's initials colour.

component/contact-avatar/badge-bg.why: Figma has no saved-contact badge on avatars.

component/contact-avatar/badge-icon.why: Figma has no saved-contact badge glyph.

component/plan-badge/expired-bg.why: Fills the 'Plan Expired' badge next to the logo with Figma's red base #CD3200 so white text reads at 5.2:1.

component/profile-hero/status-bg.why: Premium You tab status bar is white, as the token says; dark now matches the first stop of the revised hero gradient. On the no-plan tab the status bar should use component/profile-hero/no-plan-bg instead.

component/profile-hero/status-text.why: Status bar time and icons are pure black in Figma (token had #111111); the header is light in both themes, so dark is black too.

component/profile-hero/plain-bg.why: You tab without a plan (Figma: Profile Android › Without Premium, node 8:157214): the mint header with 20 dp bottom corners. Dark value derived (lime rule, same darkness as other tinted dark surfaces).

component/info-note/bg.why: Blue-tinted note that explains missing contact access.
component/info-note/bg.darkWhy: Derived: same blue at 12% so the tint shows on dark surfaces.

component/ongoing-bar/bg.why: The 'Ongoing call – 02:34' strip under the chat header, an inverted bar so it stands out.

component/ongoing-bar/text.why: Lime text and bars on the dark ongoing-call strip.
component/ongoing-bar/text.darkWhy: Derived: Figma's dark strip is white; lime would be unreadable on it and the rule bars green in dark, so dark text is black at 80%.

component/initials-disc/bg.why: Plain white disc behind initials in the call-handling contact pickers.

component/paywall/hero-top.why: Fills the very top of the paywall hero (and status bar above it) with Figma's soft gold glow #FDEFC6.

component/takeover/text.why: Label on the Takeover pill (3.6:1, bold 14px).

component/glass-button/default.why: Frosted round icon buttons (close/back) over content.

state/chat-pressed.why: Pressed state of a chat-list row.

component/voice/player-stroke.why: Hairline around the voice-note player (turns brand green while playing).

component/choice/default-bg.why: Unselected radio card fill in call handling.

component/plan-badge/expired-stroke.why: Outlines the 'Plan Expired' pill and badge in Figma's dark red #8D0000.

component/plan-card/pill-bg.why: Fills the 'Current Plan' pill with Figma's #272727, a touch darker than the card.

component/locked/badge-stroke.why: Rings the lock badge circle in Figma's cream #FFEFC8.

component/expiry-banner/warning-icon-bg.why: Fills the circle behind the info icon on the warning strip with the strip's text colour at 6%.

component/expiry-banner/danger-icon-bg.why: Fills the circle behind the info icon on the expired strip with the strip's text colour at 6%.

component/assistant-toggle/bg.why: The assistant on/off card has its own pale lime fill; dark is lime at 8% on bg/surface.

component/preset/tint-blue.why: Behind the 3D receiver of the Handle everyday calls preset (#83E0FF at 16 %).

component/preset/tint-lime.why: Behind the robot-with-wand art on the Your Instructions › Active Instructions row (lime #BAFF29 at 18 %).

component/suggest/glow.why: The three soft blurred circles (blur 50) behind the “New suggestions coming…” card (Preset Instruction design: #00B140 at 20 %).
component/suggest/glow.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime.

component/gender/stroke.why: The unselected gender card has a very light grey outline; dark uses stroke/subtle's dark value.

component/skeleton/base.why: Skeleton placeholder fill while content loads (neutral surfaces).

component/skeleton/highlight.why: The highlight band that sweeps across a skeleton.

component/skeleton/gold-base.why: Figma "Shimmer" on gold surfaces: white at 16 % over the cream-gold card.

component/skeleton/gold-highlight.why: Figma "Shimmer" highlight: the paywall cream #FDEFC6 fading to transparent.

component/radio/ring.why: Unselected radio ring. Figma draws #C2C2C2 (1.8:1, below the 3:1 a control boundary needs), so the ring takes text/secondary like the checkbox.

button/end-call.why: The round End call button on in-app calls (Figma #E11D48): a rose red distinct from button/danger so hanging up never reads as delete. White icon 4.7:1; black icon on the dark #FF5C7A 7.1:1.

component/call-control/bg.why: Resting fill of the round speaker and mute buttons (Figma #EDEFF1); text/primary icon on it 11:1.

component/call-control/active-bg.why: A toggled-on call control (speaker on, muted): the inverse of the resting fill so the state reads without colour; icon text/on-action.

component/call-control/active-icon.why: Icon on a toggled-on call control.

fab.why: Active send button and the app-icon tile: lime fading to brand green.
fab.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

send-disabled.why: Disabled send button: the active gradient at 20% opacity.
send-disabled.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

gold.why: Fills the small 'UNLIMITED' pill next to the name and logo with Figma's #A37236 base plus a 22% light sheen, in both modes.

chip-large.why: Large action chips in the conversation and assistant sheet: white washed with lime, deeper at the bottom.
chip-large.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

chip-small-unread.why: Unread home-list action chip: a lime wash that deepens towards the bottom.
chip-small-unread.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

chip-small-read.why: Read action chip: white fading to a light grey.

takeover.why: The Takeover pill in the chat header; Figma fills it flat pale green.
takeover.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

profile-hero.why: Figma draws the hero as a gold blur plus a video, not a gradient; these stops are what it renders, slightly paler at the top than the old #F8E4A2. Dark keeps the cream panel and is derived.

ai-summary.why: Figma's card is white with green glows at top-right and bottom-left and a lime glow in the centre, so the gradient runs bottom-left to top-right (45deg), not the old 135deg. Dark re-hues every glow to lime on bg/surface #1F1F1F. Card radius in Figma is 16 (web uses 20).
ai-summary.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

gender-selected.why: The selected gender card fill is flat lime at 8% (it can point to action/unread_fill), not a two-tone gradient; the green-to-lime look comes from its gradient stroke, added as gradient:gender-selected-stroke.
gender-selected.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

status-card.why: Not in Figma; current gradient kept pending owner decision.

meet-assistant.why: Meet Your Assistant banner: white tinted 8% green with a light glow bottom-right.
meet-assistant.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

call-me.why: The 'Call me' pill: flat brand green in Figma.
call-me.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

when-chip.why: Figma's pill goes from white on the left to lavender on the right, the reverse of the token, and ends in the card colour instead of transparent. Dark is Figma's own dark frame.

do-chip.why: Figma's DO pill is a mint #EEFFF8 that fades to white toward the left; dark takes Figma's 20% dark treatment with the green re-hued to lime.
do-chip.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

paywall-hero.why: Washes the top of the Unlock Equal Unlimited paywall and Settings header with Figma's soft #FDEFC6 glow fading to white.

gold-text.why: Fills the big price digits and '400k+' with Figma's orange-to-brown radial (#FFB251 to #603600).

cta-gold.why: Fills the main Unlock / Re-Subscribe button with Figma's #A37236 base and 44% sheen; white label is 4.2:1 at the dark end but about 2.5:1 at the highlight.

status-neutral.why: Tints the top of the Waiting for Confirmation and cancel sheet cards with Figma's blurred grey #E1E1E1 glow fading to white.

status-success.why: Tints the top of the Payment Confirmed card with Figma's blurred green #C7FAD7 glow (lime-tinted in dark).
status-success.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime (#BAFF29). Accents use lime itself; tinted dark surfaces keep their lightness and saturation, re-hued to lime.

status-warning.why: Tints the top of the Payment Pending card with Figma's blurred orange glow, which shows as #FFDDC2 at the card top.

status-danger.why: Tints the top of the Payment Failed card with Figma's blurred red #FFD0D0 glow fading to white.

status-gold.why: Tints the top of the Congratulations / Welcome to Equal Unlimited card with Figma's blurred #FDEFC6 gold glow.

value-card.why: Washes the 'What Unlimited saved you' card with Figma's yellow glow fading to white (gold glow on pure black in dark).

voice-note.why: The 'Send voice note' pill and mic button: same lime-to-green as the send button.
voice-note.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

choice-stroke.why: Outline of the selected radio card: green to lime and back to green.
choice-stroke.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

setup-done.why: Perfect! / All Sorted! background: a cyan-to-lime wash.
setup-done.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime #BAFF29; green-tinted dark surfaces are re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

setup-prompt.why: 'Set up your calls' takeover: home dimmed 45%, falling to black at the bottom.

unlimited-text.why: Fills the word 'UNLIMITED' on the plan card with Figma's cream-to-gold gradient; text/accent-gold is its solid fallback.

coupon-stroke.why: Outlines the coupon ticket with Figma's orange-to-brown radial at 24%.

cta-renew.why: Fills the 'Renew your Equal AI' button on the value sheet with Figma's #D1A85C to #A0621F radial, which differs from the paywall button.

expired-badge.why: Gives the 'Plan Expired' pill and badge Figma's full red sheen; white text drops to about 2.6:1 at the highlight.

gender-selected-stroke.why: The selected gender card's border is a green-lime-green gradient (web uses solid button-primary); in dark every green becomes lime.

button-secondary.why: Default Secondary button fill (Figma Button "Secondary": white to #E4FFED).
button-secondary.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: green tints re-hued to lime at the same darkness.

button-critical-secondary.why: Critical Secondary button fill (Figma: white to #FFE0E0).

button-premium-secondary.why: Premium Secondary button fill (Figma: white to #FFF9EC) under the gold gradient stroke and label.

assistant-call.why: The disc behind the assistant on the call screen: green at the top fading to white (Figma Ellipse 353, stops 0.19 / 0.59 / 1).
assistant-call.darkWhy: Dark mode rule: every green is lime.

motion.$source: Monetization prototype (Figma): Switch 500ms ease-in-out; Coupon spring 590ms after 300ms; Pricing / Coupon Pricing 600ms after 800ms; Shimmer 600ms after 1.2s; Button Glow 300ms after 800ms; Payment Status 1022ms gentle after 2.4s; Reward Animation 6s linear.
